# GitHub logins that may release Xchonnect. One login per line.
#
# scripts/release-gate.sh accepts a release tag only when it is signed with an SSH
# signing key that one of these logins has uploaded to their GitHub account
# (Settings -> SSH and GPG keys -> New SSH key, key type "Signing Key").
# scripts/release-approval-check.sh requires the `release` environment of the publishing
# run to be approved by one of these logins; with two or more listed, by one who did not
# sign the tag (the two-person rule).
#
# Keep it in step with the required reviewers of the `release` environment and with the
# bypass list of the `v*` tag ruleset (docs/release.md, "What the owner configures").
# A change to this file takes effect for tags made after it is merged: the gate reads it
# from the tagged commit.
maximedogawa
